title: ChatGPT and Codex will share one token budget from December
short:
From December, ChatGPT chats and Codex jobs share one token pool.
Plus, Pro and Business plans. OpenAI has not said how big it will be.
Full story: https://badeifer.github.io/news/chatgpt-codex-shared-usage-pool/

linkedin:
OpenAI says ChatGPT and Codex will share one token-based allowance on Plus, Pro and Business plans starting in December. Instant chat stays outside the pool, and a heavy coding week will now cost you chat.

OpenAI has not given an exact date or a size for the new pool. Measure your Codex use now, send quick questions to Instant, and check Settings, then Usage, in the first week of December.
